notes: Manufacturer product page (luminex.be) confirms: 2x Neutrik shielded EtherCON (10/100/1000Mbps Gigabit) network ports, 4x Neutrik 5-pin XLR female DMX/RDM ports (each independently configurable as input or output, optically & galvanically isolated), and a single Neutrik powerCON TRUE1 AC power inlet (100-240VAC, max 13W) with PoE IEEE 802.3af Class 0 available as an alternate power source over the Ethernet ports (no separate PoE connector). Product code LU 01 00071. Housed in a robust metal half-19in enclosure, 220 x 175.3 x 44mm (44mm ≈ 1U height, half-rack width — two units mount side-by-side to fill a full 19in rack space); rack, truss (M10 insert), or wall mounting supported. Weight 1.42kg unpackaged. This spec covers the base rack/truss-mount "LumiNode 4"; sibling variants LumiNode 4 DIN (DIN-rail, terminal-block DMX outputs) and LumiNode 4 Wall (wall-mount) have different physical connectors and were not used here. Ethernet grade (eth-1g) confirmed explicitly by spec ("10/100/1000Mbps"); DMX/XLR5 and powerCON ports are correctly left ungraded per the grading rules.
